$comment: SAST (CodeQL) baseline, triaged 2026-10-06 for ADR-0184: false positives only (every real finding was fixed). One entry per result: rule, file and the result's partialFingerprints.primaryLocationLineHash (line is informational). Each needs a reason and expires at most 90 days after review; see docs/ops/SECURITY_CI.md.

entries.reason: False positive. inlineScriptBodies() reads only our own built index.html (apps/web/dist) to compute CSP sha256 hashes for its inline scripts; it is not a sanitizer and never sees request input. A missed tag shape would only omit a hash, which makes CSP stricter, not weaker.

False positive. The SPA file path is path.resolve(distDir, rest) and is refused unless it equals distDir or starts with distDir + path.sep (the check in the SPA route handler), so a traversal resolves to index.html, never to a file outside apps/web/dist; the read stream in sendFile only receives that contained path.
